description.value: Royal Oak is a Greek restaurant on Fraser Highway in Surrey, offering dine-in, takeout, and catering services. It operates under the tagline 'Let us do the Cooking!' and presents itself as a neighbourhood Greek dining destination. Touring cyclists on the Fraser Highway corridor will find a sit-down meal or takeout option here.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms a real, operating Greek restaurant at 15336 Fraser Highway, Surrey, BC V3R 3P5, with phone (604) 581-3330 — the address matches OSM; the phone was absent from OSM tags but provided on the website. The site has dedicated 'Take out Menu' and 'Dine In Menu' navigation sections, directly confirming takeout availability. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, wi-fi, water refill, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in the OSM tags.
concerns: OSM tags contain no phone number; phone (604) 581-3330 sourced from website only — contact_confirmed.phone set to null.
Contact email on website (royaloakpizza@shaw.ca) contains 'pizza', inconsistent with the Greek restaurant branding — may indicate a legacy or rebranded business.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, operating Greek restaurant on Fraser Highway in Surrey with an active website and confirmed takeout service; a useful stop for touring cyclists on this corridor.
